verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents official client libraries that automatically send thrown errors once installed (docs-1). There is evidence of backend SDKs (Ruby gem, an Oban/Python integration that reports unhandled worker exceptions) and frontend JS packages with source-map un-minification, but nothing shows mobile SDKs. missing for 10: any evidence of official mobile (iOS/Android/React Native/Flutter) SDKs, detailed per-SDK docs on automatic uncaught-error capture for frontend and backend, independent or hands-on corroboration.
